overview:
Mirei Kuroda

No. 1 in reader survey popularity, finally appearing on Private Idol Disc!!

Volume 4 of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book starring Mirei Kuroda. Look through her photos in the Photo Hall, see how well you know her in a three-choice quiz, and get to know her better through a question-and-answer interview.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- Quiz: three-choice questions about Mirei Kuroda
- Q&A interview
- Production credits and an introduction to earlier volumes
